heroSummary:
SCUSD’s 2026–27 Traditional Student Attendance Calendar runs from Tuesday, August 11, 2026, through Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is March 22–29.

SCUSD also publishes separate attendance calendars for dependent charter schools and Adult Education, plus TK–6 and 7–12 academic calendars for term and reporting dates.

customSections.label: Which SCUSD Calendar Applies?
customSections.content: This page covers SCUSD’s Traditional Student Attendance Calendar. SCUSD also publishes TK–6 and 7–12 academic calendars for term and reporting dates, plus separate attendance calendars for dependent charter schools and Adult Education. Use the calendar that matches your school or program.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2025–26
content: The first day moves from August 18 in 2025 to August 11 in 2026, seven calendar days earlier.
The Thanksgiving-week break shifts from November 24–28 in 2025 to November 23–27 in 2026.
Winter Break begins one day earlier and runs through January 4 instead of January 2.
Spring Break starts eight calendar days earlier, moving from March 30 in 2026 to March 22 in 2027.
The last day moves from June 11 in 2026 to May 27 in 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does SCUSD start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school on SCUSD’s Traditional Student Attendance Calendar is Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SCUSD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs November 23–27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.
Winter Break runs December 21, 2026–January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SCUSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–29, 2027. Students return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every SCUSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the Traditional Student Attendance Calendar. SCUSD publishes TK–6 and 7–12 academic calendars for term and reporting dates, plus separate attendance calendars for dependent charter schools and Adult Education.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official SCUSD calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: SCUSD publishes the official 2026–27 Traditional Student Attendance Calendar as a PDF on its Academic Calendars page. You can also open that PDF from the downloads section above. Check SCUSD’s Academic Calendars page for the latest version.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the SCUSD ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook and does not automatically sync with later SCUSD revisions.
